reviews.title: Best Prediction App -Though some lines limited and lackluster daily boosts compared to competitors.
reviews.text:
Novig is probably the best prediction app right now to use, especially for states that don’t allow sportbooks. There are some negatives of you like to play future bets or heavily play soccer lines.

What I Like:
1)You can pick your own odds (assuming another party buys the reciprocal line you are offering)

2) Player props and parlays are calculated and cashed out quickly.

3) Deposit and withdrawals are seamless

Negatives:
1) Very limited future bet opportunities (season wins, conference winner, individual awards etc)

2) Bare bones soccer lines  that are tough to play - only 3 way money lines and spreads starting at +/- 1.5

3) Few to no deposit promotions as an existing customer and daily boosts for parlays or prop bets are very lackluster compared to other options.

Overall (even with my areas for improvement) I wholeheartedly recommend Novig.
